_README: Stems rewritten because the printed exam text does not survive this delivery medium.
A paper presents questions in order, so 同上題 / 承上題 works there. This app draws a
random subset and shuffles it, so a stem that points at 'the previous question' is
unanswerable. Rewrites preserve the original meaning and add only the context the
Applied by build.py AFTER dedup. Each entry asserts `was` still matches the parsed
stem, so if a parser change alters the text the build fails loudly instead of
build.py also fails if any stem still references another question and has no entry
here — that guard is what keeps this class of bug from reappearing when new papers
